title: This Thumb-Sized Squid Glows to Erase Its Own Shadow
subject: Hawaiian bobtail squid

scenes.text: A squid the size of your thumb hides from predators by glowing.
It isn't born glowing. A baby squid hatches with no glowing bacteria at all.
Out of thousands of microbe species in the sea, it lets in just one: Vibrio fischeri.
The bacteria live in a light organ and glow to match the moonlight shining down.
Predators looking up see no shadow, so the squid becomes a luminous invisibility cloak.
The squid's invisibility cloak is made of living bacteria.

description:
The Hawaiian bobtail squid hides from predators with glowing bacteria.
The light matches moonlight, so the squid casts no shadow.
Would you want a living invisibility cloak?
first_comment: A living invisibility cloak. Which animal would you want a superpower from?
